s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between intimacy and money. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
From {H:1818529904000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between relationships and your image. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.

The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between family and your career. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
From {H:1818529904000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

s.d: Treat yourself to a small comfort that costs almost nothing.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
From {H:1818529904000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between your image and relationships. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Wear a colour you really love and notice how it changes your mood.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
